perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Q2 backlog was $9.6 billion, about 92% natural-gas projects and more than 60% tied to power-generation/local-distribution demand.
The fully subscribed Amarillo Expansion links Texas Panhandle data-center demand to incremental gas infrastructure under a long-term contract.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: About $660 million of expansion projects entered service in Q2 while operations generated $2.0 billion cash flow and $1.0 billion free cash flow after capex.
Internal funding capacity and placed-in-service projects provide execution evidence beyond backlog, while contingent projects remain subject to delivery risk.

unknowns: durability of incremental data-center gas demand
